premise: On a hot day Crab cools off in the umbrella's shade, until the wind spins the umbrella and blows the ball away, and Crab scuttles after it.
inspiration: The runaway-object chase of nursery tales (the runaway pancake), made breezy: what runs away comes back when the wind drops.
lesson: A little chase can end right back where you started.

en-US.title: The Spinning Umbrella
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} It was a hot, sunny day. {crab:enter} Crab {crab:face sad} was far too warm. [sighs] Phew! Then he spotted {umbrella:enter} the umbrella, red and white, with its frilly edge. {crab:go under umbrella} He scuttled into its shade. {crab:face happy} Ahh. Lovely and cool. {crab:shake 0.4} [short pause] {canvas:wind 0.7 18s} {sfx:gust} Then, whoosh! Along came the wind. {umbrella:live} The umbrella spun round and round, its frills flapping. {crab:face surprised} And {ball:enter} the ball went bouncing past, {ball:go away right} off and away with the wind! [excited] {crab:go away right} Crab scuttled after it, sideways, as fast as he could. Click, click, click! [short pause] At last the wind dropped. {ball:go back} Back rolled the ball, {crab:go back} and back came Crab, pushing it with his claws. {ball:live} The ball spun round, and stopped. {crab:go under umbrella} Crab scuttled back into the shade. {crab:live} He did a little clicky dance. [happily] {umbrella:wobble} And the umbrella stood very, very still.

es-ES.title: La sombrilla que daba vueltas
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} Era un día de mucho sol y mucho calor. {crab:enter} Cangrejo {crab:face sad} tenía muchísimo calor. [sighs] ¡Uf! Entonces vio {umbrella:enter} la sombrilla, roja y blanca, con su borde de volantes. {crab:go under umbrella} Se metió correteando en su sombra. {crab:face happy} Aaah. Qué fresquito. {crab:shake 0.4} [short pause] {canvas:wind 0.7 18s} {sfx:gust} Y entonces, ¡fiuuu! Llegó el viento. {umbrella:live} La sombrilla dio vueltas y vueltas, con los volantes al aire. {crab:face surprised} Y {ball:enter} la pelota pasó botando, {ball:go away right} ¡y se fue con el viento! [excited] {crab:go away right} Cangrejo salió detrás, de lado, todo lo rápido que pudo. ¡Clic, clic, clic! [short pause] Por fin, el viento paró. {ball:go back} La pelota volvió rodando, {crab:go back} y Cangrejo volvió detrás, empujándola con las pinzas. {ball:live} La pelota dio vueltas y se paró. {crab:go under umbrella} Cangrejo se metió otra vez en la sombra. {crab:live} Bailó un bailecito, clic, clic. [happily] {umbrella:wobble} Y la sombrilla se quedó muy, muy quieta.
